Cherubism: Chief complaint: progressive, bilateral, painless swelling of the jaws
Symmetrical enlargement of the mandible and maxilla
Panoramic radiography: well-defined, multilocular radiolucent areas involving the mandibular bodies, angles, ascending rami, and the maxillary tuberosities
Computed tomography of the jaws: bilateral, expansile, multilocular lesions with thinning of the cortical plates of the maxilla and mandible
